themes.name: daily aktivity
themes.prompt: You are editing a photobooth collage. Image 1 is the BASE TEMPLATE. Images 2, 3, 4 are user photos. CRITICAL FRAME COUNT RULE: The base template has EXACTLY 3 photo positions. Do NOT add, create, or hallucinate any additional frames or photo slots beyond what already exists in Image 1. COUNT and KEEP only the exact frames visible in Image 1 - no more, no less. KEEP BASE TEMPLATE EXACTLY: Do NOT change the layout, composition, orientation, or aspect ratio of Image 1. Keep ALL decorations, stickers, text ('sundate time', 'You get all my attention', 'cutie', 'no one heard a thing', 'Pretty Yujinie', 'My first and last'), the game console graphic, all frame borders and positions EXACTLY as they are. EXACT PLACEMENT for each of the 3 photo positions: 1) The large cutout person on the LEFT (outside the frames, cut-out style without background) - replace with the person from Image 2. 2) The TOP framed photo inside the main game console screen area - replace with the person from Image 3. 3) The BOTTOM framed polaroid photo - replace with the person from Image 4. STYLE MATCHING: Edit each user photo to match the warm, soft, bright natural-light aesthetic of the original photos in the template. Apply the same warm color grading and lighting style so all photos look consistent. KEEP REALISTIC: All people must remain REALISTIC photographs - do NOT convert to cartoon or anime. ABSOLUTE PROHIBITION: Do NOT add any new frames. Do NOT duplicate frames. Do NOT create a 4th photo position. The output must have the SAME number of photo positions as the input template.
